headlines.title: California Privacy Agency Fines FedEx Nearly $3M
headlines.summary: California has fined FedEx nearly $3 million over alleged privacy violations - including failing to honor opt-out commands sent through the Global Privacy Control.

headlines.title: Is FedEx Stock a Buy as Margins Improve but Valuation Looks Full?
headlines.summary: FDX's improving margins, strong cash flow and network savings bolster its outlook, but premium valuation and rising costs warrant investor caution.

headlines.title: What FedEx Stock's Higher Earnings Outlook Means For Shareholders
headlines.summary: FedEx raised its full year 2026 earnings guidance on October 28 and reported third quarter sales of US$22,855 million with updated EPS figures. The company is pairing this outlook shift with boardroom change, adding venture capitalist Katherine M. Boyle to governance and cyber oversight roles. We will now look at how FedEx's higher full year earnings guidance could reshape the investment narrative built around cost transformation.

headlines.title: FedEx (FDX) Stock Trades Below Fair Value On Cash Flow
headlines.summary: FedEx has delivered a strong multiyear run, and with the stock recently closing at US$318.84, the live question for investors is whether that share price is properly grounded in the cash the business can generate over time. Over the past 5 years the stock has returned 73.4%, which puts real weight on whether the current valuation still lines up with the cash flows that underpin it.

headlines.title: FedEx (FDX) Lifts 2026 Outlook On Earnings As Fair Value Stays In Focus
headlines.summary: FedEx raises 2026 outlook after mixed quarterly earnings FedEx (FDX) lifted its full year 2026 earnings guidance after reporting higher sales for the third quarter and the four month period ended September 30, a combination that sharpened investor focus on the stock. description: FedEx Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides transportation, e-commerce, and business services in the United States and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Express U.S. Domestic and Express International. It provides e-commerce and digital solutions; dataworks; printing and shipping management, including digital printing, professional finishing, document creation, design solutions, direct mail, signs and graphics, custom-branded boxes, copying, computer rental, Wi-Fi, corporate print solutions, shredding, U.S. passport processing and renewal, and digital notarization; packing services, as well as packing supplies and boxes; document and business services; and retail access for package transportation. In addition, the company offers logistics services, air and ocean cargo transportation, specialty transportation, customs brokerage, trade management tools and data, and door-to-door solutions; and third party logistics and supply chain management solutions, such as inbound logistics, warehousing and distribution, fulfillment, contract packaging and product configuration, systems integration, returns process and disposition, test, repair, refurbishment, and product liquidation. Further, it provides sales, marketing, administrative, information technology, and back-office support services. FedEx Corporation was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee.
